variant.author: Bronya Rand
variant.changelog:
# What's New?
- Brought Compact and Portrait layouts to Native UI.
- Added tha ability to cycle between ImGui and Native UI in Settings.

(Native UI is toggled by default for new installs. If you have a reason to want ImGui as a default instead, let me know on Discord)
variant.description:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your Windows or Linux* PC's media playback from within XIV.
            > * - Linux support is only supported on official XIVLauncher Wine builds and certain Wine/Proton builds with "AF_UNIX" support.

            Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
            Features (depending on your media player):
            - Play/Pause
            - Next/Previous Track
            - Stop
            - Progress Bar
            - Cover Art Display
            - Metadata

            ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information and can be shown as a native XIV window or ImGui window.
variant.name: ProxyPlayer
variant.punchline: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
